page.layout: One page of text, single column; running head at top with page number at top left; a catchword-like word "Ad" at lower right below the last line. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: expulsionis, & quia tale superfluum potest diversis temporibus occurrere, cum eius generatio dependeat à causis diversis, nunc vno tempore occurrentibus, nunc alio & alio, iccirco tempus periodici motus non est vnum, sed diversum. Similiter & aggregatio superfluitatis quæ dependet ex defectu virtutis digestiuæ non habet tempus præcise determinatum, sed diversum secundum diversitatem eorum quæ occurrunt intrinsecus & extrinsecus, Hæc ille. Interceptio ergo paroxysmorum dupliciter contingere potest, aut ratione expultricis facultatis, aut ratione superflui aggregati. primum adhuc dupliciter, aut quia non stimulatur, facto sensu hebetio ri, aut ob fortem animi motionem expultricem ab opere suo perturbantem. Ad primum modum reducuntur medicamenta ea, quæ virtutes habent narcoticorum, vt theriaca, athanasia, philonium Romanum, quæ sanare quartanas febres experientia comperium est. Id etiam discimus ex Galeno ijs diversis locis vtente, ad sanationem febris quartanæ.

page.notes: The final "Ad" at lower right is a catchword and is also printed as a word; the transcription keeps it as catchword. Some words in the running text are faint; "vt theriaca," and "comperium" are doubtful readings.
